integrity: The theorem is supported by an explicit Gaussian jet regression proof and separately checked finite numerical consistency calculations; computation is not substituted for the analytical limit.
scientific_limitations: Real nonnegative Gaussian/first-Hermite mixing only; ordered unsigned two-point zero contact, not finite-distance correlations or arbitrary complex-phase mixing. General Kac–Rice machinery is prior work. Absolute publication priority and independent mathematical audit unverified.
title: Complete angular contact law for zeros of mixed Gaussian–Hermite spectrograms
